description:
[Live official EU/Global registry lookup. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Verifies European VAT validity via official VIES API, extracts official registered legal company name and address, queries GLEIF for Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) corporate hierarchy, and screens against consolidated EU, OFAC and UN sanctions lists.
Usage: Use this tool when you already have a European VAT number to verify against statutory registries and check sanctions. If you only have a company website URL and need to discover its VAT number from legal footers, use 'b2b_tech_profiler' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { isValid: boolean, countryCode: string, vatNumber: string, name: string, address: string, lei: string | null, sanctionsCheck: { isSanctioned: boolean, matches: array }, verificationTimestamp: string }.

companyName.description: Optional company name for cross-check and LEI lookup

countryCode.description: 2-letter EU country code (e.g. IT, DE, FR, ES)

name: vies_gleif_kyb_verify
title: VIES & GLEIF KYB Verification
